# jans_scripts_by_type (Data Source)

Data source for looking up custom scripts by their type (GET /config/scripts/type/{type}).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `script_type` (String) The script type to look up (e.g. person_authentication, introspection).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `scripts` (List of Object) The scripts of the given type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scripts))

<a id="nestedatt--scripts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scripts`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `dn` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `inum` (String)
- `level` (Number)
- `location_path` (String)
- `location_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `programming_language` (String)
- `revision` (Number)
- `script` (String)
- `script_type` (String)
